easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, creating five Treasure tokens.
Activate Extruder five times by sacrificing five Treasures, putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
